record.name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
record.one_liner: An open-source and enterprise e-commerce platform providing extensive REST and GraphQL APIs for online stores.
record.access_note: Magento Open Source is freely downloadable, and developers can set up local environments or trial instances without cost.
record.api_note: Covers catalog, cart, pricing, inventory, orders, customers, and administrative actions via REST and GraphQL.
